cmd: ethtool -C eth0 adaptive-tx on rx-usecs 0 sample-interval 5 rx-frames-low 2 cqe-mode-tx on tx-aggr-time-usecs 100 rx-cqe-frames 4
desc: corner: dev=eth0 arx=absent atx=on rxu=0 rxf=absent txu=absent txf=absent irq=absent rate=sample-interval lowhigh=rx-frames-low cqe=txon aggr=usecs rxcqe=frames
pre: i=$((900+$(ip netns identify | tr -dc 0-9))); echo $i > /sys/bus/netdevsim/del_device 2>/dev/null; echo "$i 1 4" > /sys/bus/netdevsim/new_device && ip link show eth0 >/dev/null
